'''Kar'a'katok''' was a [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Shimholt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. More than four [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] before the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Nelori Marauders]] launched a devastating [[invasion of Kar'a'katok]] that the Shimholt were able to eventually fight off.

Afterward, dissatisfaction with the planetary government led to a coup in which a faction of Shimholt religious fanatics came to power. The Shimholt zealots oversaw the fortification of Kar'a'katok against future invasions as well as increasing seclusion of the species and its homeworld, a state that lasted for four thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. Eventually, [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of the Empire carried out a [[Raid on Kar'a'katok|raid]] on the planet that saw the capture and subsequent [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] of Shimholt [[Suprema (title)|Suprema]] [[Suprema|Ampotem Za]].

==Description==
Kar'a'katok was a terrestrial, mist-enshrouded [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Hyperspace" /> located in the [[Kar'a'katok system/Legends|Kar'a'katok system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
[[File:SUPREMA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Suprema Ampotem Za was exiled from Kar'a'katok following his capture by the Galactic Empire.]]
At some point at least several [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] prior to [[4050 BBY]],<ref name="4050 date">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'' establishes that [[Arca Jeth]] was instrumental in the overall defeat of the [[Nelori Marauders]] and that the group was active "[[Standard decade/Legends|decades]]" prior to Jeth becoming a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. In addition, ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' and ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' both establish that Jeth had attained that rank by the [[Time/Legends|time]] he participated in the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Battle of Lorell|victory]] over the [[Lorell Raiders]]. Since ''[[Galaxy at War]]'' dates the defeat of the Lorell Raiders to approximately [[4050 BBY]], the Nelori Marauders must have been active decades prior to that date.</ref> the band of warriors,<ref name="CSWE Nelori">{{CSWECite|II|369|Nelori Marauders}}</ref> outlaws,<ref name="TotJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref> and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]<ref name="CSWE Dachat">{{CSWECite|I|160|Dachat}}</ref> known as the [[Nelori Marauders]] launched a devastating [[invasion of Kar'a'katok]]<ref name="Hyperspace" /> in order to [[Slavery/Legends|enslave]] the [[Shimholt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to it.<ref name="CSWE Nelori" /> The natives, however, refocused from agriculture toward military self-defense and drove the incursion off. Afterward, many Shimholt, angry over their [[Democracy/Legends|democratically]] elected government's inability to prevent the invasion, demanded a change in the planetary leadership. A fanatical religious faction of the Shimholt soon staged a coup that toppled Kar'a'katok's government and put the zealots in power. Subsequently, an unprecedented effort was launched to strengthen the planet's defenses against any would-be invaders. Kar'a'katok was further decreed to be closed to offworlders, and departing the planet by any Shimholt was made a [[Death/Legends|capital]] crime. The resulting seclusion of the Shimholt homeworld went on to last for four [[Millennium/Legends|thousand]] years.<ref name="Hyperspace" />

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] launched a [[Raid on Kar'a'katok|raid]] on Kar'a'katok at some point following its [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]]<ref name="Hyperspace" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The operation saw [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Stafuv Rahz]] capture the Shimholt [[Suprema (title)|Suprema]] [[Suprema|Ampotem Za]] and take him offworld. Za eventually escaped the Empire and returned to Kar'a'katok. However, the other Shimholt shunned and [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] Za for having allowed himself to be taken away from his homeworld. At that point, Za surrendered to Rahz, and eventually he came to work for the Empire offworld.<ref name="Hyperspace" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|Shimholt}}
Kar'a'katok was the homeworld of the [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species known as the Shimholt. At one point a friendly people who [[Farmer/Legends|practiced]] agriculture, the Shimholt were deeply affected by their homeworld's invasion by the Nelori Marauders. They became [[Speciesism|xenophobic]] and reclusive and were rarely seen in the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], leading to the species being nearly forgotten by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the Galactic Empire.<ref name="Hyperspace" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kar'a'katok was first mentioned in "[[Aliens in the Empire]], Part 1: Hierarchy of Power," a [[November 6]], [[2007]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] article written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Rich Handley]],<ref name="Hyperspace" /> with Handley specifically authoring the section<ref name="TFN1">{{JCFCite|url=posts/27825175|board=Literature|thread=Aliens in the Empire (Part 2 now up)|user=[[Abel G. Peña|Halagad_Ventor]]|date=2007-12-05|time=5:00 PM|quote=As he did with the Shimholt, Rich did an amazing job fleshing out the culture of the Gektls in so few words.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200801202856/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/aliens-of-the-empire-part-2-now-up.27707732/page-5#post-27825175|archivedate=20200801202856}}</ref> mentioning the planet.<ref name="Hyperspace" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Kar'a'katok [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Kar'a'katok itself, in grid square K-9.<ref name="TEA" />
